channel.title: MySQL · Lynn Lee's Site
channel.description: Engineering notes by Lynn Lee: advertising data systems, Flink, MySQL, Java and AI agents. Design decisions, failure boundaries and verification.

item.title: Consistency Boundaries in MySQL CDC: Snapshots, Offsets, and Idempotency
item.description: Trace duplicates, reordering, deletes, and replay from MySQL through Debezium and Kafka to downstream state.

item.title: MySQL Concurrency: MVCC, Lock Waits, and Deadlocks in One Example
item.description: Use two sessions to understand snapshot reads and conflicting updates, inspect deadlocks, and design retries at the transaction boundary.

item.title: MySQL Index Design: Reading EXPLAIN Through a Slow Query
item.description: Connect query shape, composite indexes, actual scan volume, and write costs through a practical event-log query.

item.title: MySQL Study Notes: Locks, Lock Ranges, and Deadlocks
item.description: An English reading edition of the 2023 notes on global, table, metadata, intention, auto-increment, and row locks, with practical inspection and recovery guidance.

item.title: MySQL Study Notes: Transactions, Logging, and MVCC
item.description: An English reading edition of the 2023 notes, covering isolation, undo and redo, binary logs, commit coordination, replication, and buffer-pool behavior.
